jobs.title: Director, Global Financial Reporting and Analysis , Global FP&A
jobs.description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

The Director leads the network reporting and analysis activities within the wider Financial Planning and Analysis Team

What You Will Do

Internal financial Reporting - Delivery of the aggregated financial results of the KPMG network, including the reporting of revenues, headcount and profitability metrics
External financial reporting on KPMG’s global results to the market and the Professional Indemnity Insurance (PII) reinsurers.
Business planning and strategic analysis in support of KPMG’s Collective Strategy, providing Board-level insight and including competitor analysis.
Continuous improvement and change management, driving evolution of reporting to meet the business’ information requirements.
Process and team management lead, coach and develop four direct reports and coordinate the work of the offshore team members.
Management of the annual process that reviews the Global Taxonomy of Services, which defines the reporting and supports risk management.

What You Bring To The Role

A minimum of 8 years of relevant financial reporting and analysis experience, with an accounting qualification
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
Extensive reporting systems experience, with SAP or similar and interest in applying automation and AI
Advanced capability in data manipulation & modelling with a creative approach to presenting information to stakeholders
Experience operating in a global, matrixed environment, across different cultures, ideally with experience of directing offshore teams and expert knowledge of a professional services firm
A collaborative approach to building relationships with stakeholder

The expected base salary range for this position is $125,000 to $175,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

Providing you with the support you need to be at your best

Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity
, we do what is right | Excellence
, we never stop learning and improving | Courage
, we think and act boldly | Together
, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better
, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.

AI Usage

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering, AI
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about transforming how legal professionals find trusted answers with AI? Join our Global Westlaw Engineering organization and help shape the future of AI-driven legal research.

Westlaw helps legal professionals around the world research, analyze, and act with confidence. We are building the next generation of fiduciary-level, AI-powered legal research and workflow capabilities, and we are changing how we build software.

As Director, you will lead a global organization of engineering managers, senior engineers, and vendor partners. You will own the multi-year AI engineering strategy and its alignment with the product delivery roadmap. You will move the organization to mission-based teams with clear ownership and accountability. You will also drive the shift to AI-assisted, agent-driven development and use engineering data to guide decisions and show results.

We want a technical leader with a track record of leading AI transformation, who leads by example, stays hands-on, keeps up with AI and engineering best practices, uses data to find what needs to change, and empowers teams to innovate across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead

Lead a high-performing global organization. Set clear expectations, coach managers and engineers, and lead by example, using AI tools and engineering data in your own work.
Stay close to the technical work. Work directly with senior engineers on architecture, technical direction, and hard problems to raise the technical bar across the organization.
Own Engineering strategy implementation and its alignment with the product delivery roadmap. Run it as a living plan with clear milestones and owners, adapt quickly as priorities evolve, and recommend measures that keep engineering objectives aligned to business strategy.
Lead the transformation to a mission-based operating model. Replace project-by-project handoffs with long-lived teams that own a product area, service, or customer outcome from design through production support. Define each team's mission, scope, decision rights, and the skills and authority it needs.
Set measures for each mission. Define measures such as reliability, quality, delivery speed, adoption, and cost. Review them regularly and use them to guide priorities, resourcing, and accountability.
Manage the vendor relationship. Help the vendor keep pace with business needs. Integrate vendor-managed teams into the organization, with clear scope, outcomes, service levels, and governance. Hold them to the same standards as internal teams for architecture, quality, security, and delivery, and measure their performance with the same data. Make sure they document their work and transfer knowledge, so the organization does not depend on a single vendor.
Decide what to do in-house, with partners, or through vendors. Balance cost, speed, capability, risk, and long-term knowledge retention.
Communicate proactively. Show how your organization's work delivers business value and supports strategy, and work directly with stakeholders and peers to shape the future of our products.

Deliver

Deliver strategic projects with urgency. Partner with Product Management, UX Design, and other Technology teams. Remove blockers, make timely decisions, and enable your teams to solve complex business problems with clearly defined outcomes.
Drive the end-to-end AI lifecycle. Own the work from retrieval and model integration through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Set the standard for operational excellence. Hold AI and non-AI services to high standards for reliability, security, performance, and cost. Champion a DevOps-first model supported by automation, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code on AWS.
Manage the project portfolio. Own budget, priorities, and staff allocation.

Operate: Run a Data-Driven, AI-Enabled Organization:

Provide guardrails and empower teams to use AI. Equip managers, engineers, and teams to apply AI in daily engineering work, including coding assistants, agents, code review, test automation, and quality evaluation. Provide clear guardrails for responsible use, covering security, data handling, and human review of AI-generated code and outputs. Within those guardrails, encourage teams to experiment and adopt AI, and remove the barriers that slow them down.
Make decisions with data. Analyze GitHub data, such as pull request cycle time, review latency, build and deployment frequency, and AI tool usage, to find bottlenecks and show where change is working.
Track ownership and accountability. Use incident response, change failure rate, and cycle time by team to show whether ownership and accountability are improving. Share results openly, use them to coach rather than blame, and turn them into practical changes in how teams work.
Measure the impact of AI. Track its effect on delivery speed, code quality, defect rates, and reliability. Use those measures to adjust strategy and investment.
Own the economics of AI usage. Set AI budgets, and track and optimize token consumption, inference cost, and tooling spend. Guide model selection and cost-versus-quality trade-offs, balancing them against productivity, quality, and speed.

Innovate

Stay on top of the AI landscape. Follow new models, agent frameworks, tool protocols such as MCP, and retrieval patterns. Judge what is production-ready, bring it into your teams' practices, and grow adoption of AI/ML engineering practices and frameworks across the enterprise.
Try new approaches. Take informed risks. Encourage your managers and teams to do the same, and recognize those who do.

Required Qualifications

Education. A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience. 10+ years in software development, including 3+ years leading AI solution development, and 10+ years managing managers and building high-performing engineering teams in an agile environment.
Organizational leadership. Experience leading managers, individual contributors, and vendor-managed teams, including scope, performance, cost, and quality. You can coach managers on people leadership and engage credibly with Staff and Principal engineers.
Strategy and execution. Experience turning a multi-year vision into programs, roadmaps, and measurable results across multiple teams, including large-scale rollouts and infrastructure initiatives.
Shipping AI in production. A track record of shipping LLM-based applications, RAG, or agent workflows in production-grade software. You can speak credibly about prompt and context design, retrieval, evaluation, and production trade-offs.
Cloud, DevOps, and reliability. Strong depth in cloud-native architecture on AWS, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, and experience running mission-critical, high-availability systems.
Hands-on AI tool use. Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code). You lead by example and have empowered managers and teams to adopt AI-assisted development, with strong practices for review, quality, and security.
Data-driven leadership and AI economics. Experience defining and analyzing metrics such as DORA, cycle time, quality, and adoption to find problems and show results. Working knowledge of token usage, inference and tooling costs, and how to measure the return on AI investment.
Leading change. Experience shifting team mindsets, introducing new tools and ways of working, and moving teams to mission-based, outcome-owned models with clear ownership, decision rights, and accountability.
Communication. Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex technical and financial trade-offs to executives and customers and align stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading globally distributed teams and restructuring an engineering organization around products, services, or customer outcomes.
Agentic systems and responsible AI. Experience shipping agentic systems in production, including evaluation, benchmarking, and monitoring, and knowledge of AI guardrails and governance.
LLM APIs, search, and agent frameworks. Experience with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) at scale, information retrieval or search systems, and standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Vendor and cost management. Experience with vendor selection, contract negotiation, and transitions between vendor and in-house teams. Experience managing cloud and AI cost through FinOps or inference cost optimization.
Career paths. Experience building career paths for both management and technical (IC) tracks, and retaining senior technical talent.
Technical background. Strong Python and RESTful API design skills. AWS certifications, such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, are a plus.
Domain background. Background in legal or other regulated, content-rich professional domains.

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.
